title: AnchorRecord
description: What one device says about the anchor, as the other receives it: the anchor's state and nothing else. Stored as one JSON value under the key furlough.anchor.v1.

sequence.description: Monotonic across every device: each write is one past anything either has seen. A record whose sequence is not strictly greater than the local one changes nothing.

isAnchored.description: Whether the writer's anchor is down.

anchoredAt.description: When it went down. Absent when nothing is holding.

until.description: When a timed hold ends. Absent means only a paired tag lifts it, which is tighter than any date. Judged by the receiver's own clock.

writer.description: The writing device's id, the same string it signs its roster entry with.

platform.description: What wrote it. An iPad runs the phone build and has no tag reader, so it is its own case: it can be anchored and can never release.

origin.description: How the write came about. drop: by hand, from a widget or Control Center, or by the schedule. tagScan: the one release, a paired tag read by a phone. lift: a timed anchor's until passed, informational only — the receiver computes the same expiry and refuses it as a release.

writtenAt.description: The writer's Furlough time at the write.
